北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今日阴冷，体感 -7℃，记得多穿衣，别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is gloomy and cold today, feeling like -7℃. Remember to dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，能见度低，出门开车、步行都请注意安全！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has fog with low visibility. Please stay safe when driving or walking outdoors!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温 14℃，体感略凉。注意适时添衣，保持舒适。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, 14℃, feeling a bit cool. Add clothes as needed to stay comfortable.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光明媚，气温 25℃，暖暖的很舒服。注意补水哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 25℃, very pleasant. Remember to hydrate!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗宜人，气温 25℃。阳光虽好，别忘防晒与补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant at 25℃. Enjoy the sun, but don't forget sunscreen and hydration!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，14℃ 体感微凉。出门别忘带件外套，以防风寒。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feeling slightly cool at 14℃. Bring a jacket when going out to prevent colds.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低。驾车慢行，注意交通安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has fog, with low visibility. Drive slowly and stay safe on the roads.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，气温 16℃，体感舒适。享受这好天气吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with a comfortable 16℃. Enjoy the pleasant weather!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾又冷，体感 2℃。出行务必注意安全与保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy and cold, feeling like 2℃. Please ensure safety and warmth when out.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 0℃，比较寒冷。外出记得多穿保暖衣物。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and chilly, feeling like 0℃. Remember to wear warm clothes when going out.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有霾，气温 18℃。出门请佩戴口罩，注意防护。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has haze, 18℃. Please wear a mask when going out for protection.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -27℃！务必做好最强保暖，谨防冻伤。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feeling like -27℃! Ensure maximum warmth to prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -27℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗但严寒，体感 -20℃。外出注意防寒，戴好帽子手套。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but severe cold, feeling like -20℃. Protect from cold; wear hat and gloves.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，气温 20℃，体感舒适。享受“春城”好时光。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is perfectly sunny, 20℃, feeling comfortable. Enjoy the "Spring City" weather!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗，气温 18℃，体感温暖。正是海边散步的好时机！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny and 18℃, feeling warm. Perfect time for a stroll by the sea!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感 -5℃。风力较大，出门注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is gloomy and cold, feeling like -5℃. It's windy, so dress warmly and protect from wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感 -12℃。风大，请务必多穿，保护头部。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is gloomy and cold, feeling like -12℃. It's windy, so dress very warmly, especially your head.
